verdict.rationale: Supabase documents running a local Supabase stack through its CLI with `supabase init` and `supabase start`, and self-hosting the services with Docker. A runtime probe confirmed the CLI ran from npm with no account or login. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents fully offline operation, CI test workflows, or parity between the local stack and the hosted engine, so coverage is incomplete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of offline (no-network) operation, a documented CI testing workflow on the local stack, a statement that the local stack is the same engine as hosted, and a hands-on run of `supabase start` without login (only `--version` was probed).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the same engine locally and keylessly — no account or cloud dependency — for offline development and CI tests

citations.quote: supabase start to launch the Supabase services
Develop locally using the CLI to run a local Supabase stack
the official Supabase CLI ran keylessly from npm — `npx -y supabase --version` printed `2.117.0` with no account or login
The fastest and recommended way to self-host Supabase is to use Docker.
